name: pantothenate kinase 3

function.text: PANK3 is the approved symbol for pantothenate kinase 3. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in acetyl-CoA binding; pantothenate kinase activity; coenzyme A biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: PANK3 encodes pantothenate kinase 3. It catalyzes the phosphorylation of pantothenate to generate 4'-phosphopantothenate in the first and rate-determining step of coenzyme A (CoA) synthesis.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PANK3 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.
